description: This file is a shell script that defines a comprehensive set of tests for verifying the behavior of 'git status' output during various complex Git operations, including rebasing, merging, cherry-picking, bisecting, reverting, and more. It uses a series of test cases to ensure that the status output correctly reflects the repository state under different scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: A function to set up and run a test case expecting success outcome.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: A function that runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: A function to compare actual and expected output.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: A function to write lines to a file.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: A function to check that the output is empty.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: A function to register cleanup commands to be run after the test.

methods.description: A function to create a commit with specified files and message.
